properties.name: NEAR_MATCH_LIMIT goes from 3 to 6, and a test pins that a crowded band is not reported as three
properties.rationale:
Anthony's word, 2026-09-21, after the cause was measured rather than asserted. The session had first told him the guard was "failing at its own job", which named no mechanism and implied the check was broken; it was not — it ran, and had reported correctly twice in the preceding hour.

WHAT THE MEASUREMENT ACTUALLY SHOWED: replaying the guard's own query, nine non-self hits cleared the floor, three were shown, and the genuinely duplicated node sat at rank 4, six thousandths of a point behind rank 5 on a 245-point score. The candidate that would have refuted the whole complaint — that the guard is lexical and was being asked a semantic question — was tested and refuted, because the node cleared the floor on wording alone.

THE LESSON THAT COST THE MOST TIME IS ABOUT THE TEST, NOT THE FIX. The first two versions of the test failed for the wrong reasons, and both are recorded in the file: identical seed text collapses BM25's IDF so nothing clears the floor at all, and a probe carrying vocabulary the band lacks raises its own score and therefore the floor with it. A test that fails is not yet a test that fails for the reason you think.

⚠️ AND ONE CONSEQUENCE STATED SO IT IS NOT REDISCOVERED: the constant governs what is REFUSED as well as what is shown, because refuse_unless_deliberate reads the truncated list. Doubling it doubles how many unacknowledged near-matches can block a write. That is the trade Anthony took knowingly; if it proves noisy, splitting the two numbers is the follow-up, and the reason they are one number today is that it stops the guard refusing on a match it never showed.
properties.stands_in_for: The proper fix is not a bigger cut but a different instrument for "is this a near-duplicate". The floor is half the NEW NODE'S OWN score, and a node scored against its own text sits structurally far above every other hit — 474 against a next-best 283 in the 2026-09-21 measurement — so the floor lands in the MIDDLE of a dense band rather than at its edge, and any fixed cut then selects an arbitrary slice of a near-tie. Raising 3 to 6 buys margin against that and does not change the shape: an eleventh close node is still invisible, and ranks either side of the new cut can still be thousandths of a point apart. What would correct the cause is a cut derived from the SHAPE of the score distribution rather than a constant — break at the largest gap in the band, or exclude the self-hit from setting the baseline so the floor tracks the neighbourhood instead of the query — or a judgement that BM25 rank is the wrong signal here and something else decides relatedness. Anthony chose the constant on 2026-09-21 with the trade stated; this records it as the containment it is.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: NEAR_MATCH_LIMIT moves from 3 to 6 in crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs, and crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_near_match_report_is_not_cut_at_three.rs pins the class: a band of eight close nodes must not be reported as three, and the report must stay inside the 12-hit query window so removing the cap is not a way to make it green. The constant's doc comment now carries the measurement, the fact that it governs the REFUSAL as well as the report, and the reason it is a containment rather than a correction.
